named_assumptions.statement: Fixed ABI (64-bit pointers/size_t, 8-bit char, little-endian) is a declared parameter of the model; conformance of any real hardware/compiler is NOT proved here.
Theorems are about abstract C semantics of the modelled fragment (CExec), NOT machine code. Translation C→machine code and its correctness are outside P01; the C compiler stays in TCB.
named_assumptions.explicit_per_TASK: TASK §4: 'Świadomie określ, czy theorem dotyczy C semantics czy kodu maszynowego'

named_assumptions.statement: Translation correctness covers the declared used fragment grammar `return <decimal>;` (plus a separately-labelled synthetic shape witness). Translation of operator-rich source17 fragments (e.g. fpr_ursh) is an explicit missing type for downstream tasks, not an assumed lemma.
No cryptographic assumptions are made or smuggled: real PRNG/SHAKE/ChaCha/KeyGen/Sign are outside P01 and appear in no theorem premise.

Trusted computing base: Lean4.34.0 kernel + pinned Mathlib4@5ed2965 definitions (PMF, ENNReal, Real.sqrt) + SageMath10.9 only as certificate producer (all numbers re-checked kernel-side by decide in Lean: sqrt2Witness_checked, *_transport).
totalVariation/directedChi2 quantified over Fintype observation spaces; the pinned instance uses Bool (Fintype). Infinite state spaces are handled only through pure/deterministic steps.
